## Load and combine sample data

```{r}


sample_path <- "/home/projects/exam_2026_22102/group2/intestine_data/sample_seurats/"

#reading the seruat objects
B006 <- readRDS(str_c(sample_path, "B006_seurat.rds"))
B008 <- readRDS(str_c(sample_path, "B008_seurat.rds"))
B010 <- readRDS(str_c(sample_path, "B010_seurat.rds"))
B011 <- readRDS(str_c(sample_path, "B011_seurat.rds"))
B012 <- readRDS(str_c(sample_path, "B012_seurat.rds"))



B006$donor <- "B006"
B008$donor <- "B008"
B010$donor <- "B010"
B011$donor <- "B011"
B012$donor <- "B012"


EC <- merge(
  x = B006,
  y = list(B008, B010, B011, B012),
  add.cell.ids = c("B006","B008","B010","B011", "B012"),
  project = "AllDonors"
)


# checking if meta data was perserved
table(EC$donor)

# Joing layers so count matrix and such is pooled
EC <- JoinLayers(EC)

# Saving the seurat 
saveRDS(EC, file = "/home/projects/exam_2026_22102/group2/intestine_data/sample_seurats/EC_seurat.rds")

dim(EC) # dim before subsetting, 545083 3569104
```

# QC of the data

## Percentages of mito and ribosomal

```{r}
#Mitochondrial genes
EC@meta.data[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(EC, pattern = "^MT-")

#Ribosomal genes proportions
EC[["percent.ribo"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(EC, pattern = "^RPS|^RPL|^rps|^rpl")

```

```{r}
for (f in features) {
  x <- EC[[f]][,1]
  x[is.na(x) | is.infinite(x)] <- 0
  EC[[f]] <- x
}
```

```{r}
colSums(is.na(EC@meta.data[, c(
  "nFeature_RNA",
  "nCount_RNA",
  "percent.mt",
  "percent.ribo"
)]))
```

```{r}
# Mito genes (adjust pattern if needed)
EC[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(EC, pattern = "^MT-")

# Ribosomal genes
EC[["percent.ribo"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(EC, pattern = "^RPS|^RPL")

```

```{r}

# making identity same for all
Idents(EC) <- factor(rep("all-cells", ncol(EC)))
levels(Idents(EC))

# Restoring the identity: 
# Idents(EC) <- EC$donor

# Visualize QC metrics as a violin plot
p <- VlnPlot(EC, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt", "percent.ribo"), ncol = 4, group.by = NULL)
p
```

# Random subsetting data

```{r}

set.seed(123) # seed for reproducibility

cells.use <- unlist(
  lapply(
    split(Cells(EC), EC$donor),
    function(x) sample(x, 8000)
  )
)

EC <- subset(EC, cells = cells.use)

dim(EC) # dim subsetting

```
